newsitem.title: UK: BOC up after U.S. presentation, Goldman view.
newsitem.headline: BOC up after U.S. presentation, Goldman view.

text.p: Shares in BOC Plc put on 22-1/2p to 1,054-1/2p after a presentation from BOC's finance director at Goldman Sachs' Chemical Investor Forum in Atlanta, Georgia, dealers said.
Goldman analyst Charles Brown reiterated his "market outperformer" rating on the stock after the conference meeting.
BOC said finance director Tony Isaac gave a recap on the group's first-half results, released in May. He repeated news that:
-- underlying growth in gases was nine percent a year.
-- the large number of new plant commissions will deliver a boost to future earnings.
-- the company sees an improving order intake for vacuum products in the semi-conductor industry.
Isaac also noted that U.S. investors had built up a near ten percent holding in the company since its U.S. listing in September.
Highlights also included the company's strength in core units such as industrial gases, its broad geographic spread, strong position in Asia and higher yield than most other gas companies.
Goldman's Brown left his eps forecasts unchanged at 1996/97 57.8p per share, 1997/98 66p and 72.1p for 1998/99.
